title: Pencil Drawing — an idea becomes a connected system

scenes.title: The idea is drawn
scenes.purpose: Build the central idea as a graphite sphere study: construction guides, exploratory contour, committed contour, then layered hatching for volume.
visuals: Static cool bristol paper (#ECEEF0) with a faint graphite drafting grid
Rough.js construction axes and an exploratory light contour
Three hatch layers (midtone, shadow crescent, core cross-hatch) plus stump smudge and hatched cast shadow

beats.development: Faint construction axes and a loose exploratory circle are sketched in, then the darker committed contour begins to trace over it.

The 'fig. a — the idea' note is wiped in. Midtone, shadow-crescent and core cross-hatching are laid stroke by stroke, a stump smudge deepens the shadow side, and the hatched cast shadow appears beneath.

scenes.title: Connections reach out
scenes.purpose: Show the idea becoming a system: pencil connectors travel outward and each node is drawn as its line arrives.
visuals: Six double-pass Rough.js connector lines with soft graphite under-drawing halos
Five node circles with exploratory and committed contours and small hatched shadow crescents
Caption 'study no. 4 — an idea becomes a connected system'

beats.development: Three first-generation connectors finish drawing; nodes A, C and B are sketched as each line reaches them.
Second-generation links branch to the last two nodes, which get their contours and shading. The caption is wiped in alongside them.
captions: study no. 4 — an idea becomes a connected system

scenes.title: Settled study
scenes.purpose: Hold the finished drawing so the caption and the network can be read.
visuals: Complete, stationary pencil study and both notes fully legible

beats.development: Nothing moves. The completed system and caption hold for reading.
captions: study no. 4 — an idea becomes a connected system

findings: The drawing follows pencil order: construction, contour, hatching, connectors, nodes, notes.
Connector and node cues are offset by 50–80 ms so the eye follows the lines outward instead of everything popping at once.
Everything has settled by 2.25 s, before the 2.7 s requirement.
justifiedHolds: 2.25–3.0 s: final reading hold for the 8-word caption and the finished network.

notes: Style: style-022 Pencil Drawing (graphite contours and layered hatching on paper).
Silent preview: no music, effects or voice.
Background refresh: cool bristol paper #ECEEF0 with graphite #383838 (contrast ~10.1:1), replacing the earlier warm paper. Monochrome graphite only, no accent ink.

Lessons applied from the source frames: a grid substrate, an exploratory construction state before the crisp form, hatch density for emphasis, and smudge halos as under-drawing. No source lettering or composition was copied.
